statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while weekend energy and geopolitical uncertainty keep Stress high.
recommendation: The published state is descriptive: low Tail, high Stress, and no live NQ price path while futures are closed.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low; energy and geopolitical uncertainty sustain high Stress
body: NQ is closed, so current one-way structure, shallow pullbacks and retracement failure are unobservable. Friday ended with Nasdaq gains led by semiconductors despite negative breadth, Treasury yields above 5% and crude above $100. Weekend oil-supply and Hormuz risk keep Stress high without establishing a higher Tail state.

sources.title: Reuters: Friday oil and Middle East supply risk
Associated Press: Iran rally and Strait of Hormuz tanker claim

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was in WATCH through much of active Friday trading, peaking at 24%, then fell to low levels after the close; the latest closed-market hour held Tail at 10%. Stress stayed high to extreme while Confidence remained high to very-high.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend NQ closure. Tail stays low because no future price path is treated as observed; Stress remains high to extreme as energy-supply, shipping and geopolitical headlines can alter later reopening expectations.

forecast.analysis: Weekend closure: NQ has no live price path. Friday was two-way; high yields and oil keep Stress high without current retracement-failure evidence.
